title: Counterexamples to an all-positive Brannan coefficient inequality
description: An exact negative answer to the all-positive generalized coefficient question recorded as Hayman--Lingham Problem 5.44, together with a degree-three endpoint classification and rational counterexamples at every integer index at least three.
